chronicle.text: Shebeibal came back for food left 8 weeks before, and it was still there.
Gubai tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Zozir found that what Veilais had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
Zozir went back to what they had left in one spot a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Beihazo attacked Sozais: the first violence.
Kushul tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Sainei drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Roubol gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Zozir set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
Lakoukeim told Roubol that Taiko could be believed: reputation passed on by word.
Roulaki scratched a mark <||/> into the ground.
At (27, 21) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Gubai had put in the most.
Gaihas struck flint with flint and stared at what happened.
Gaihas struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Gaihas tied a blade and wood together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
Taiko tied a stone flake and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Sainei crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Veilais took in the orphan Seinek, no relation, the first time a stranger raised another's child.
Zaizer took up striking wood with stone from a mark: the first thing learned from a record.
Zaizer came on the mark <vo^> and took it to mean wood being struck: the first mark read as a message.
Gaihas struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
A hungry year: 4 people starved.
Sainei found that what the mark <|/-> seemed to say was wrong, and put less faith in that mark.
Sainei buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
3 people now take the mark <v-o> to go with shelter, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

The mark <o/-> has drifted: it went with stone being struck, and now, for 5 people, with rabbits.
Beihazo killed Bodoun after being attacked by Bodoun in year 17.
Revenge answered revenge: the feud between the kin of Beihazo and the kin of Bodoun had begun.
3 people now tell that Bodoun attacked Sozais. It was Beihazo. The story changed as it was passed on.

A thirsty year: 3 people died for want of water.
